The overall effect of this adaptation of the 2010 film of the same name is wearying in the extreme and indicative of the sea change – irreversible, I have a feeling – of a bygone musical era made up of genuine mavericks and the one we inhabit now that exists merely to crib, pastiche, reassemble.
